'''Mandalore the Infernal''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who held the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] at some point prior to the [[Great Galactic War]]. Mandalore the Infernal requested the design of missiles involving [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|thermonuclear]] fusion.<ref name="Onslaught" />
